finding: THE PRECONDITION HOLDS, ON TWO BODIES, WITH THE SAME TWO INVERSIONS
verify_quoted: the local and global orders must actually DIFFER for the chosen body, shown from its own anatomy row, or the experiment cannot discriminate.
why_this_first: G021's experiment needs GPU. Its precondition does not. If local and global agreed, the allocation run could not distinguish them and the hours would buy nothing -- this is the cheap discriminator the campaign keeps being paid by.

body_1.verbatim: local k>q (global q>k) and local down>gate (global gate>down); the three 100% laws hold; allocation uses the GLOBAL prior
body_1.note: G017 RAN THE GLOBAL PRIOR. The local ordering has never been the allocation driver.

body_2.local_order: k > q > o > v > down > gate
inversions_vs_global: k > q, against the global q > k
down > gate, against the global gate > down

the_result: TWO OF TWO independently measured bodies inverT the global prior on the SAME TWO adjacent pairs. Both put k above q where the aggregate puts q above k, and both put down above gate where the aggregate puts gate above down. A prior that no measured specimen matches on those pairs is not a prior over specimens; it is an artifact of the aggregate.
what_this_licenses: the G021 experiment CAN discriminate -- local and global give different allocations on a named body, shown from its own anatomy row, which is exactly what the verify demands before the run. It also raises the prior odds: the hypothesis is no longer 'one body disagreed' but 'both bodies we have measured disagree the same way'.
what_this_is_NOT: not the experiment. Nothing here allocates, quantizes or measures capability. Local ordering predicting its own allocation BETTER than the global prior is unproven, and [S007 9] forbids widening to a 50-model sweep on the strength of two bodies agreeing -- the correct next step is the discriminating run on ONE of them, not more anatomy.
an_uncomfortable_detail: body 2's anatomy is NOT IN THE LEDGER. It was measured three times, by rounds 22, 24 and 25, and every one of them ended without calling record_measurement. The evidence for this finding lives in .hcli round receipts rather than in G034, which is the G006 story stated from the other side: the science happened and the campaign's own ledger does not know it.
evidence_tier: RECEIPT_SURVEY -- no new measurement, no GPU
scar: CHECK THE EXPERIMENT CAN DISCRIMINATE BEFORE BUYING THE HOURS. It cost one grep here.
